slate_notes: Sunday: NFL Week 11 (NE vs DET Munich kicked off 9:30 AM ET, skipped), 9 NBA, 5 NHL (WinDaily had no NHL prop prices yet). 8 legs in 8 different games: 6 NFL, 2 NBA. Every est_prob is a multiplicative two-way devig at the exact same half-point line from WinDaily's best-price-per-side comparison (DK/FD/BetMGM/Fanatics/Hard Rock/BetRivers). NFL prices are from Sat 9:01 AM ET and NBA from Sat ~9:19 PM ET, so they're stale. Best-price pairing understates hold, so treat est_prob as slightly high. The two NBA legs are single-book FanDuel pairs. PrizePicks/Underdog lines are UNCONFIRMED from the box; drop any leg whose app line differs or is a Goblin/Demon. Game logs were built from ESPN box scores (ESPN's NFL gamelog endpoint has misaligned columns). Dropped market-vs-trend conflicts (Metchie, Judkins, Watson, Freiermuth, Maxey) and WinDaily roster mismatches. Kirk Cousins was just traded to MIN, so his first start makes the U1.5 too uncertain. No college props. Avg est_prob ~0.613. Recheck NFL inactives (~11:30 AM / 2:30 PM ET) at finalize.

Trailing script raises attempts, but this offense has struggled to finish drives. Weather at MetLife: 51F with intermittent clouds (ESPN). Wind not checked.
